property_summary: For any nonzero withdrawal amount, when the owner calls withdraw(amount) the contract's balance decreases by that amount (reference uses transfer which reverts on failure), whereas the mutant's unchecked call may return without transferring funds so the contract balance may not decrease for some adversarial callee;
change_summary: Replace transfer to send with a low-level call that does not revert on failure, so withdraw may not actually transfer funds while still returning (no require on success).
